note: The contract is M2/experiments/M2-1-PASSIVE-QIMB/freeze.json (sha256 03efd04e032317a19c67105c35ab2196248d616507296246a18e46e52b83e7d0), sealed before the canonical replay was executed and not modified since. pre_result_corrections.defect: executions did not reduce the quote book, so attempt prices, mids and exit quotes could reference a phantom price level whose quantity had already been executed
pre_result_corrections.detected_by: the queue_ahead_zero_share signal (26% of attempts joining a level with zero displayed quantity) on the first full replay, before any economics were read
pre_result_corrections.fix: every level-affecting event now reduces the quote book; a level_state_mismatches counter compares this accounting against each symbol's own book on every submission
invalidated_runs: trace windows on the same code

pre_result_corrections.defect: the queue accounting and the level FIFOs were keyed by (side, price) globally, so two symbols quoting the same price shared one queue and the quantity ahead of a hypothetical order was inflated
pre_result_corrections.detected_by: level_state_mismatches = 1,492,983 (61% of attempts) with order_map_truth equal to the aggregate and the book under-counted, plus a divergence trace showing four different symbols at $212.50
invalidated_runs: fifo_ttl1000ms_secondary and no_queue_ttl1000ms_secondary from the first corrected pass (overwritten by the final pass)

pre_result_corrections.defect: the optimistic no-queue bound, required by freeze K1 and by the identifiability assessment, did not exist in the first sealed revision of the code; and the analysis module mixed raw and USD price units and used a hybrid EV unit
pre_result_corrections.detected_by: the identifiability assessment's own requirement that the queue-attribution gap be bounded, and the analysis unit test before any real table was read
pre_result_corrections.fix: added the no_queue fill model; exit prices converted to USD; per-attempt value reported both in dollars and in bps of one order's notional; a fixture test with hand-computed markouts pins the arithmetic
invalidated_runs: none (no real result had been produced)
